# Commission guidelines on AI Act Article 5 (prohibited practices)

<!-- generated by _system/build.py from _sources/ — do not edit; rerun the script -->

C(2025) 5052 final, 29 July 2025. Not binding: this is the Commission's reading of Article 5, and only the EU Court of Justice can interpret the AI Act with authority (paragraph 5). Written before the 2026 amendment, so it says nothing on Article 5(1)(ba), (bb), (1a) or (1b).

One file per subsection; subsections over ~6k tokens are split one heading level down, and a section's opening text goes with its first file. Each file carries its own footnotes. Paragraph numbers run through the whole document: cite as "Art 5 Guidelines para N".
